products.name: Arceus Poster Box
products.note: Five Arceus packs, a poster, the Arceus promo and a jumbo DP50 (PokeBeach title, toywiz; the jumbo is not simulated).

products.name: Arceus Three Pack Blister [Cresselia]
products.note: Two Arceus packs and one Mysterious Treasures pack, a coin and the Cresselia promo (Collector's Cache product pages, Bulbapedia excerpt, joshscards; the coin is not simulated).

products.name: Arceus Three Pack Blister [Darkrai]
products.note: Two Arceus packs and one Mysterious Treasures pack, a coin and the Darkrai promo (as the Cresselia blister).

products.name: Arceus Collector's Tin [Green, Arceus LV.X]
products.note: First wave, November 2009: one pack each of Arceus, Supreme Victors, Rising Rivals and Platinum (loosepacks.com Tin Contents Database). PokeBeach's summary says 3 Arceus, 2 Diamond & Pearl or Platinum and 1 POP 9 pack: the two sources conflict, medium-low confidence.

products.name: Arceus Collector's Tin [Blue, Arceus LV.X]
products.note: Second wave, December 16, 2009: two Arceus packs, one Rising Rivals (or Supreme Victors) and one Stormfront (or Secret Wonders) pack (loosepacks.com; PokeBeach says two Arceus and two Diamond & Pearl or Platinum packs): medium confidence.
